meta.title: Tool doctor
meta.description: Mechanical tool-call failures cost the model a full round-trip: a range past end of file, a stringified number, a whitespace-drifted edit anchor — the host refuses, the model rewrites and retries. Tool doctor removes that tax: arguments are repaired before dispatch, and recognized failures are retried through the host's own runtime at the bound the host states, adopting only genuine successes; anything else keeps the original error exactly as the model would have seen it. Open Tool doctor in Plugin Manager to review outcomes, recurring errors, and rule settings. Supported patterns only; remaining failures stay visible. Records stay in the DSH home directory; guidance edits return to the factory default after a plugin restart.
